items.duty_text: Issue and circulate written or electronic materials containing information about domestic violence and child abuse, and distribute them to eligible homeless persons at an intake facility.

Determine the content to include in the shelter-specific training.

Conduct two trainings per year on best practices for improving interactions between department personnel and shelter residents.
Include specified techniques in the customer service training.
Provide the training to all department employees and covered contractor employees who have direct contact with shelter residents.

Make mental health professionals available in each families with children shelter to provide on-site mental health services, maintaining at least one full-time mental health professional for up to every 50 families with children.
Consult with shelter operators in determining the types of mental health professionals providing mental health services to families with children.
Ensure that required information is not reported in a manner violating applicable federal, state, or local privacy law concerning individuals in shelter.
The department must not require any child who is a member of a family with children to be present at an intake center when that family applies or reapplies for shelter.

items.duty_text: Develop an outreach program to provide the written materials to specified hospitals for distribution to patients.

Make best efforts to coordinate with specified hospitals during code blue and code red alerts to identify individuals experiencing homelessness being discharged, assess needed department resources and services, encourage their use, and directly make those resources and services available.
items.deadline_text: during a code blue alert and a code red alert

items.duty_text: Include direction to drop-in centers, shelters, warming centers, and cooling centers, including during extended hours, and transportation to those locations among the resources and services made available.

Subject to appropriation, make best efforts to coordinate during code blue and code red alerts with specified hospitals to make certain supplies available to each individual experiencing homelessness being discharged from a hospital during such alerts.

Not require an applicant residing in a shelter operated by or on behalf of the Department of Homeless Services or Human Resources Administration to have resided a specified number of days in that shelter to be eligible for a rental assistance voucher.
Provide monthly rental assistance to an owner or landlord on behalf of a household receiving a rental assistance voucher.
Provide specified utility-allowance reductions and payments when a household rents a unit below the maximum rental allowance and utilities are not included in rent.
